title: Founder / Fractional Chief AI Officer
excerpt: Founded an AI product consultancy for Fortune 500s and venture-backed startups — LLM systems, voice and chat assistants, and clinical-grade patient communication automation with hard guardrails.
html:
Founded and ran an AI product consultancy delivering LLM systems, voice and chat assistants, natural language search, and computer vision into production environments for Fortune 500 enterprises and venture-backed startups.

Highlights

  • Served as fractional Chief AI Officer, setting AI strategy and system architecture for client product and engineering teams
  • Designed patient communication automation for major regional health systems, consolidating distributed communications into a centralized hub with LLM-driven handling of routine outbound messaging
  • Architected LLM systems inside deterministic state machines with hard guardrails on every path and explicit escalation to human staff — automation in clinical contexts without ceding clinical judgment to a model
  • Led technical due diligence on AI products and engineering organizations for investors and acquirers
